newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Winterthur takes over Colonial Insurance NZ.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur takes over Colonial Insurance NZ.

text.p: WELLINGTON, July 17 (reuter) - Australian listed group HIH Winterthur Insurance said on Thursday it had acquired all the shares in Colonial Mutual General Insurance NZ Ltd.
The acquisition was made through Winterthur's New Zealand subsidiary, HIH Casualty and General Insurance NZ Ltd.
Winterthur is a subsidiary of Swiss company Winterthur Insurance Co.
"Colonial will distribute HIH Winterthur's various insurance products through the Colonial franchise network," HIH Winterthur said in a statement.
Earlier this year, HIH Winterthur established a strategic alliance with Colonial in Australia through the acquisition of Colonial's Australian general insurance operations.

"In Australia, HIH Winterthur were early starters in targeting alliances with financial institutions as being one of the major growth areas for general insurance," HIH Winterthur NZ managing director Ross Chapman said.
He said the Colonial NZ acquisition provided a good opportunity to diversify HIH Winterthur's New Zealand operations into the household and small business insurance market.
